mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.outbound_no, s.supplier_code, s.supplier_name, o.purpose, o.source_doc_no, o.status, o.remark, o.released_at FROM outbound_order o JOIN supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT l.line_no, m.material_code, m.material_name, l.planned_qty, l.picked_qty, w.warehouse_name, sl.location_name FROM outbound_order_line l JOIN material m ON m.id = l.material_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = l.target_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN storage_location sl ON sl.id = l.target_location_id WHERE l.outbound_order_id = #{id} ORDER BY l.line_no ASC
